label: Page-1 result box: 1 There is no presumption of abuse / 2 calculation will be made under Form 122A-2 / 3 Means Test does not apply now (military)
why: Every filing must check exactly one; it is the form's outcome and must agree with line 14a/14b (or the 122A-1Supp). No schema field writes CheckBox1.

label: How do the lines compare? 14a: line 12b <= line 13 / 14b: line 12b > line 13
why: Required comparison result; it decides whether Form 122A-2 is filed. Both widgets share field name '14a'; the export values distinguish them.

label: What is your marital and filing status? Check one only.
why: Required; it determines whether Column B is filled. Note the misspelled export value 'Maried#20and#20filing'. Marital status is not collected (DIG-53).

label: Married, spouse NOT filing: living in same household / living separately or legally separated
why: Required when CheckBox3 = Married#20but#20not#20filing; 'separately' is a declaration under penalty of perjury (707(b)(7)(B)), so it must be an asked answer.

label: Fill in the state in which you live.
why: Required. Currently receives the median-income figure; no binding produces the state (e.g. from DebtorInfo.state).

label: Fill in the number of people in your household.
why: Required. Currently receives annualized income; household size (rule family_size) is written into line 9 instead.

label: Fill in the median family income for your state and size of household.
why: Required for the line 14 comparison. Currently receives (annual CMI - median); the median itself goes to 13A.

label: Total current monthly income (line 11 total, p2 T19) and its copy on line 12a (p2 T20) - one field, two widgets
why: The form's central figure. Currently receives an ANNUAL amount; no binding writes monthly CMI here.

label: Column A per-source monthly income (wages line 2, business line 5, rental line 6, interest line 7, unemployment line 8, pension line 9, other line 10)
why: All per-source rules return a constant 0.00, so Column A lines 2-10 never sum to the CMI on line 11. IncomeInfo stores only a 6-month total array.

label: Net monthly business income / net monthly rental income (each fills the worksheet box and the Column A 'Copy here' box)
why: No binding targets these; they are needed whenever the debtor has business or rental income.

pdf_field: terrorism If necessary list other sources on a separate page and put the total below 1
label: Income from all other sources - source description, row 1 (row 2: '... below 2')
why: A line-10 amount needs its source named; there is no binding.
